The Project

Built on the water,
finished to the last detail.

RIVERTON RESIDENCES sits directly on the riverfront promenade, minutes from the centre and open to the water on three sides. Five floors, private terraces, a landscaped forecourt and a residents' lobby staffed around the clock.

42Residences
5Floors
3–5Rooms
2027Delivery
The Residences

Light first, everything else after.

The Living Floor

Full-height glazing across the entire western wall, a terrace deep enough to dine on, and the skyline turning gold every evening from your own sofa.

Materials

Natural stone floors, brushed-brass fittings, solid timber joinery and lighting integrated into the ceiling line. Specified once, for thirty years.

The Lobby

Double-height, staffed reception, private lounge and concierge service.

The Promenade

Direct access to the riverfront walk, the park and the bridge crossing.

Parking

Two underground levels, private storage and EV charging at every bay.
